sonnet.problem: Card 1 ends by quoting "How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!" That already tells the baker Israel did not test God only once, so the false statement on card 2 is given away.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Card 3 already quotes "They did not remember His power…" and says they forgot the day God redeemed them. That gives away the right answer, "To show the power Israel forgot." The text also never says why Asaph lists the signs, so the question asks for a reason the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Card 5 says God hears it and "He is furious." That gives away the right answer on card 6, "He was angry with His own people," and none of the wrong answers are about anger.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
